title: Woman with a Parasol (Claude Monet)
moodDescription: Impressionist plein-air radiance; billowing white muslin and dappled sunlight dancing in a breezy summer meadow

regions.label: The Green Parasol
regions.spokenLabel: The bright green parasol tilted against the sun, casting gentle translucent shadows over the lady's face.

regions.label: Madame Monet's Billowing Dress
regions.spokenLabel: Madame Monet viewed from below, her voluminous white dress caught by the wind, standing heroically against the summer sky.
regions.timbreDescription: Warm chamber violins & gentle acoustic harp

regions.label: The Boy (Jean Monet)
regions.spokenLabel: Monet's seven-year-old son standing waist-deep in the meadow behind his mother, straw hat resting on his head.
regions.timbreDescription: Delicate music box bell & plucked acoustic pizzicato

regions.label: Grass Meadow & Wildflowers
regions.spokenLabel: A wild upward-sloping field painted in rapid brushstrokes of ochre, clover, and flecks of brilliant yellow blossoms.
regions.timbreDescription: Warm upright double bass & strummed acoustic warmth

regions.label: Azure Sky & Dynamic Clouds
regions.spokenLabel: A vibrant blue sky streaked with whipping cirrus clouds echoing the speed and joy of the wind.
regions.timbreDescription: Airy breathy synth pad & high string harmonics
